Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.61 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc
and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Balrampur.

3.  In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant 8 months ago and subsequently on 23.02.2023, the daughter died on account of the injuries inflicted by the entire matrimonial family.
The cause of death as per the postmortem report is shown as coma due to cerebral hypoxian as a result of ante mortem hanging.
Four injuries were present on Lakhan Pandey Alias Lakkha vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Prin. Secy. Home ...

sentences.text: the body of the deceased being abrasion on the front side of the neck, contusion on the forearm below elbow joint and lower lip and upper back.

4. It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that the co-accused Radha, the mother-in-law, has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 18.07.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9004 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9004 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the fact that there is no specific allegation that the applicant had victimized the deceased in relation to the demand of dowry soon before death coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 28.04.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Lakhan Pandey alias Lakkha be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
